Bio

The work, end to end

Energy and environmental engineer, based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. I work on solar PV and hybrid wind–solar across the length of a project rather than one stage of it — design, implementation, operation, and the disclosure that follows.

Across the project

  • DESIGN
    Feasibility and generation modelling
    Hybrid wind–solar, with evacuation in the model from the first pass — HT/LT routing, interconnection at the TANTRANSCO substation, and the open access structure that decides the economics. In Tamil Nadu that means GEOA 2025: 8% in-kind banking, monthly settlement, no banking against third-party sale, wheeling at ₹1.03 and cross subsidy surcharge at ₹2.06 for FY 2026-27. Captive and group captive dominate for a reason.
  • IMPLEMENTATION
    PV construction quality monitoring
    Inspection against specification, deviation carried to closure — through HT/LT work, substation connectivity, and the metering that makes wheeling real. Under ALMM List-II, bill-of-materials traceability is a commissioning risk, not a procurement detail.
  • OPERATION
    Yield, reconciliation and the record
    Generation tracking, wheeled-energy reconciliation against TNPDCL metering, and the documentation that makes the whole thing auditable after the fact.

And around it

IPO and listing. Technical and ESG inputs to the offer document at Progen Renewables — DRHP and RHP support under SEBI ICDR, business and risk-factor content, project data through due diligence and SEBI observations, working alongside the company secretary and the bankers, and BRSR as a continuing LODR obligation after listing.

An offer document is a compliance report with underwriters attached. Every number in it has to trace to a source someone will test.

Environmental quality. ISO 14001. Before that, SMETA/SEDEX 4-Pillar audit coordination — labour standards, health and safety, environment and business ethics — with supplier codes of conduct, corrective actions carried to closure, and ETI Base Code and ILO convention training. Compliance work is where I learned what a claim costs to substantiate.

Life cycle. Solar is low-carbon in operation, not in manufacture; the honest number sits between the two. ISO 14040 and 14044 as method — functional unit, boundary, inventory, impact — applied to module embodied energy and payback, land and cleaning water, end-of-life, and the grid carbon actually displaced at the point of injection. With CBAM in force and CCTS targets binding, that accounting has stopped being academic. I hold this as method rather than as a completed study.

Research background. Monsoon variability, ENSO–IOD coupling, reference evapotranspiration modelling, and a long experiment running current through the root zone of amaranth. The same instinct throughout — a suspicion of numbers nobody has checked.

Featured research

Running a current through the root zone: electrostimulation and the growth of Amaranthus in controlled environment agriculture

Low-intensity DC applied to the root zone, characterised by current density rather than raw voltage — so the electrical dose is reproducible across replicates instead of being an artefact of one rig. Matched control and treated groups, treatment scheduled across growth stages, outcomes measured on biomass, leaf area and chlorophyll.
